name: onenote-mcp
description: Read, search, and write your Microsoft OneNote notebooks from Claude.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your Microsoft OneNote notebooks.

Ask Claude to find a note, summarize a page, pull action items out of meeting notes, or write a new page for you — without leaving the conversation.

**What it can do**
- Search your notes by title or full text
- Read any page, with formatting preserved as readable text
- See your whole notebook structure in one step, including section groups
- Create new pages and append to existing ones
- Organize notes into new sections

**Where your notes go**

Straight from Microsoft to your own computer, and then into your conversation. Nothing passes through any third-party server — there is no server. No analytics, no telemetry, no tracking of any kind. The author of this extension receives nothing: not your notes, not your email, not even a count of how often you use it.

**What it can access**

Only notebooks you own, in your own account. Not notebooks shared with you, not group notebooks, and not password-protected sections — Microsoft blocks those outright. It cannot see your email, calendar, contacts, or files.

Pages are fetched only when you ask about them — never in bulk, never indexed. No note content is ever written to disk. When you search inside your notes, the pages read are kept in memory for 60 seconds so follow-up questions are fast; that cache never leaves the process and vanishes when you quit.

**Turning off writing**

Switch off "Allow Claude to change your notes" below and it becomes read-only. For a stronger guarantee, set permissions to 'Notes.Read offline_access' and Microsoft itself will refuse any write.

**Full details**

Every permission is explained line by line, with instructions for verifying the claims yourself, in PRIVACY.md in the project repository.

**Signing in**

After installing, just ask Claude to list your notebooks. A browser window opens for you to sign in to Microsoft. That happens once.

prompts.name: summarize_recent_notes
prompts.description: Summarize what you have written recently
prompts.text: Look at my ${arguments.count} most recently modified OneNote pages using listPages, read each one with getPage, and give me a short summary of what I have been working on. Group related notes together.

prompts.name: find_action_items
prompts.description: Pull action items out of your notes
prompts.text: Search my OneNote for pages about "${arguments.topic}" using searchPages with searchContent enabled. Read the matching pages and extract every action item, task, or commitment you find. Present them as a checklist, noting which page each came from.

prompts.name: daily_note
prompts.text: Create a new OneNote page in the "${arguments.section}" section, titled with today's date. Include this content, formatted clearly: ${arguments.content}

default_section.title: Default section for new notes
default_section.description: Optional. Name of the section new pages should go to when you do not say where (e.g. "Ideas" or "Learn / Cooking"). Leave blank to be asked each time.

image_mode.title: When to read images
image_mode.description: Images cost far more than text (a screenshot is worth roughly a page of writing), so they are not read every time. "auto" reads them only when a page has too little text to answer from, and otherwise tells Claude they exist so you can ask. "always" reads them every time. "never" skips them.

cache_mode.title: Remember pages between sessions
cache_mode.description: Keeps the text of pages you have already read on THIS computer, so re-reading an unchanged page costs nothing. Stored in your private config folder, readable only by your account, scoped to your Microsoft account, and never sent anywhere. A page is re-downloaded the moment OneNote reports you edited it. Set to "memory" to keep it only for the current session, or "off" for no caching. Clear it any time by signing out.

allow_write.title: Allow Claude to change your notes
allow_write.description: When on, Claude can create pages, add to existing pages, and delete pages. Turn this off to make the connection read-only.

client_id.title: Microsoft application ID
client_id.description: Leave blank to use the built-in application. Only fill this in if your organization requires you to use your own Microsoft app registration — paste the Application (client) ID here.

tenant_id.title: Microsoft account type
tenant_id.description: Leave as 'common' unless your IT department told you otherwise. Use 'consumers' for personal Microsoft accounts only, 'organizations' for work or school accounts only, or paste your organization's tenant ID.

scopes.title: Permissions requested from Microsoft
scopes.description: Advanced. Leave as-is unless you know you need more. The default covers only your own notebooks. Use 'Notes.ReadWrite.All offline_access' to also reach notebooks shared with you and group notebooks.
